title: Front End Web Developer
subtitle: About PATI Group
body:
# About PATI Group

PATI is a fast-growing E-commerce business specializing in dietary supplements, achieving a remarkable 500% increase in sales within just one year in the United States market. We're on a mission to become the leading dietary supplement company in Vietnam by 2026, offering innovative and high-quality products that inspire our customers to optimize their physical, mental, and intellectual potential.

As we continue our rapid growth trajectory, we're seeking a visionary** Front End Web Developer **to lead our growth efforts and drive us towards these goals.

# Job summary

As a** Front End Developer** at PATI Group, you will be a pivotal contributor to the success of our Direct-to-Consumer (DTC) e-commerce business by ensuring the performance, scalability, and innovation of our Shopify platform. Your primary objective will be to develop and optimize eCommerce solutions that drive seamless user experiences, empower our Men’s Health and Women’s Health collections, and support the company’s ambitious revenue targets of $25M by 2025 in all channel including but not limited to Shopify, Amazon, and TikTok Shop. In this role, you will collaborate with cross-functional teams, resolve technical challenges, enhance Shopify functionality to strengthen the technical foundation of our eCommerce operations.

# How We Measure Success

- **Conversion Rate Improvement: **Drive improvements in our site's conversion rate through innovative UI/UX design and implementation.

- **Speed of Implementation: **Efficiently develop and deploy new features or updates, maintaining high standards of code quality.

- **Adoption of Best Practices: **Adhere to and promote Shopify's best practices, modern web development standards, and progressive enhancement techniques.

- **Bug Resolution Rate:**Quickly identify, troubleshoot, and resolve bugs to maintain a seamless user experience.

# Essential Roles and Responsibilities:

- Develop and maintain eCommerce sites on the Shopify platform, including custom themes, Liquid programming, and third-party app integration.

- Lead the development and delivery of technical projects (CRO)LTV/ Business Development), including managing internal and external teams and conducting A/B testing to optimize performance

- Ensure website optimization, speed, and security, and explore third-partexpand functionality

- Research and evaluate new technologies (AI + Automation) to enhance our products and processes/SOPs, contributing to internal ecommerce-related projects.

# Skills and Qualifications

## Technical Skills:

- **4+ years of experience** in website development, with expertise in Liquid templating, theme customization, and app development.

- Strong proficiency in front-end technologies, including **HTML5**, **CSS3**, **JavaScript** (ReactJS/NextJS/NodeJS), and **TypeScript**.

- Familiarity with **Google Analytics** for Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO) and hands-on expertise in Google Content Experiments for testing.

## Behavioral Competencies and Soft Skills

**Behavioral Competencies:**

- **Integrity:** The foremost and essential quality.

- **Data-Driven Decision-Making:** Ability to make logical, unbiased decisions while maintaining authenticity and empathy.

- **Discipline:** Consistently upholding high standards with no tolerance for undisciplined behavior.

**Soft Skills:**

- Outstanding problem-solving skills paired with sharp attention to detail.

- Strong communication abilities, fluent in both written and spoken English.

- Proactive mindset with a dedication to continuous learning and staying ahead of eCommerce trends.

At PATI Group, every position must align with our **core values and behaviors**. We make no exceptions in ensuring candidates are a cultural fit. Learn more about our culture here: [PATI Group Culture](https://www.patigroup.com/t/culture).

## Nice-to-Have Requirements:

- **1+ years of experience** working with Shopify.

- Familiarity with **Shopify API**, **GraphQL**, and **Shopify CLI**, as well as best practices in theme development.

- Experience with AI and automation tools for eCommerce.

- Knowledge of other eCommerce platforms, such as **Magento**, **WooCommerce**, and **BigCommerce**.

# Compensation and Benefits

- **Salary Range:** Attractive monthly salary starting from 1.500$ depending on experience (open to negotiate).

- **Performance Bonuses: **Annual bonuses can be up to 10 months of salary, based on performance measured by net profit, SOP, and adherence to cultural key behaviors.

- **Equity Offer:** Potential to transition into a CTO role with an equity offer.

- **Professional Development:** Gain access to the latest AI tools, automation technologies, and advanced CRM systems to stay ahead in delivering exceptional customer experiences.

- **Workplace Culture:** Join a dynamic, innovation-driven environment focused on employee success.

- **Additional Benefits:** Social insurance, statutory leave, and team-building activities.

## Working Location

- **Working Location:** On-site, 18A Street No. 38, An Khanh Ward, Thu Duc, Ho Chi Minh, Vietnam.

- **Working Hours:**

Monday - Friday: 8:30 AM - 5:30 PM, with a 1-hour lunch break.

- Saturday (Culture Day): 6:30 AM - 09:00 AM. We kick off Saturdays with team runs and weekly reflections - mind, body, and momentum aligned.

*Make sure you have read and agreed to our working location and hours, including working on Saturday mornings.*
